faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about TriggerFlow

setup.question: How long does the setup take?
setup.answer: Setup is quick and simple. On average, our customers are operational in less than 48 hours. Our team supports you every step of the way to configure your first automations.

pms.question: Is TriggerFlow compatible with my PMS?
pms.answer: We are compatible with major PMS on the market: Mews, Opera, Protel, Clock, Misterbooking, Asterio, Thaïs and many more. If your PMS is not on the list, contact us to check compatibility.

customization.question: Can I customize the messages sent?
customization.answer: Absolutely! All messages are fully customizable. You can use dynamic variables (guest name, stay dates, room number...) and adapt the tone to your property.

marketing.question: What marketing actions can I automate?
marketing.answer: TriggerFlow allows you to automate many actions: welcome SMS/emails, satisfaction surveys, additional services offers, loyalty programs, post-stay follow-ups and much more.

trial.question: Do you offer a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes, the Discovery plan is free and allows you to test your first scenarios. For paid plans, we offer a 14-day no-commitment trial.

support.question: How does support work?
support.answer: Our team supports you at every step: initial setup, team training, and 7/7 support via chat, email or phone.

meta.title: Terms of Sale | TriggerFlow
meta.description: General terms of sale for TriggerFlow services.

object.title: Purpose
object.content: These general terms of sale define the contractual conditions applicable to any subscription to TriggerFlow services by a business customer. Any use of the service implies unconditional acceptance of these terms.

services.title: Services Description
services.content: TriggerFlow is a SaaS platform for automating hotel customer relationships. Services include: synchronization with PMS, automatic sending of SMS and emails, satisfaction surveys management, additional sales module, and statistics dashboard.

pricing.title: Pricing and Payment Terms
pricing.content: Prices are indicated in euros excluding tax. VAT will be applied at the current rate. Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually in advance. Payment is made by bank card or SEPA direct debit. Any late payment will result in automatic suspension of services.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content: Payments are secure via our partner Stripe. Accepted payment methods are: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and SEPA direct debit. Invoices are available in your customer portal.

duration.title: Duration and Renewal
duration.content: Subscriptions are taken out for a minimum period of one month or one year depending on the formula chosen. Unless terminated before the deadline, subscriptions are renewed automatically for the same period.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: The customer can terminate their subscription at any time from their customer portal. Termination takes effect at the end of the current billing period. No refund will be made for the remaining period.

liability.title: Liability
liability.content: Utelys SAS commits to make its best efforts to ensure service availability. However, Utelys SAS cannot be held responsible for interruptions due to maintenance, technical failures or causes beyond its control. Compensation cannot exceed the amount paid by the customer over the last 12 months.

jurisdiction.title: Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.content: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, and after failed attempt at amicable resolution, Paris courts will have exclusive jurisdiction.

meta.title: Terms of Use | TriggerFlow
meta.description: General terms of use for TriggerFlow services.

acceptance.title: Terms Acceptance
acceptance.content: By accessing and using the TriggerFlow platform, you expressly agree to these terms of use. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use our services.

access.title: Service Access
access.content: Access to TriggerFlow services is reserved for business customers. To use the platform, you must create an account by providing accurate and up-to-date information.

account.title: Account and Security
account.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials. Any activity carried out from your account is your responsibility. In case of suspected breach, please contact us immediately.

usage.title: Service Usage
usage.content: You agree to use the service in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including those relating to electronic communications (GDPR, anti-spam laws). You are responsible for the content of messages sent via the platform.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Use
prohibited.content: It is forbidden to: send unauthorized commercial messages (spam), use the service for illegal purposes, attempt to access non-authorized parts of the system, share your account with third parties, collect personal data without consent.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: The TriggerFlow platform, including its code, design and content, is protected by intellectual property rights. You are granted only a limited right to use the service within the scope of your subscription.

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be informed of significant changes. Continued use of the service after modifications implies acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding these terms of use, you can contact us at: contact@trigger-flow.com

meta.title: Privacy Policy | TriggerFlow
meta.description: Privacy policy and personal data protection for TriggerFlow.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Utelys SAS, publisher of TriggerFlow, is committed to protecting the privacy of its users and customers. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with the GDPR and the Data Protection Act.

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.content: We collect: identification data (last name, first name, email, phone), connection data (IP address, logs), usage data (platform usage, preferences), payment data (processed securely by Stripe). Guest data transmitted by your PMS remains your property.

purpose.title: Purposes of Processing
purpose.content: Your data is used to: provide and improve our services, manage your account and subscription, send transactional and commercial communications (with your consent), ensure platform security, comply with legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis
legalBasis.content: Data processing is based on: contract performance (service subscription), consent (newsletter, cookies), legitimate interest (service improvement, fraud prevention), legal obligation (accounting, tax).

retention.title: Retention Period
retention.content: Your data is retained for the duration of the contract plus 3 years for commercial prospecting. Payment data is retained in accordance with accounting obligations (10 years). Cookies are retained for 13 months maximum.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content: Your data may be shared with: our technical subcontractors (hosting, payment), competent authorities on legal request. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have: access right, rectification right, deletion right, opposition right, portability right, right to limit processing. To exercise them, contact: dpo@trigger-flow.com. In case of dispute, you can contact the CNIL.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our site uses: necessary cookies (platform operation), analytics cookies (audience measurement), advertising cookies (with consent). You can manage your preferences in your browser or via our cookie consent banner.

security.title: Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data: encryption, secure access, employee awareness, regular audits.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding your personal data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer: dpo@trigger-flow.com

comparison.title: Detailed plan comparison

changePlan.question: Can I change plans at any time?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. The change takes effect immediately and billing is adjusted pro-rata.

commitment.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
commitment.answer: No, all our plans are commitment-free. You can cancel at any time with 30 days notice.

trial.question: How does the free trial work?
trial.answer: You get a 14-day free trial on paid plans, with access to all features. No credit card required to start.

groupRates.question: Do you offer pricing for hotel groups?
groupRates.answer: Yes, we offer volume discounts for multi-property groups. Contact our sales team for a custom quote.

smsIncluded.question: Are SMS included in the plans?
smsIncluded.answer: Conversion and Marketing+ plans include 500 and 1000 SMS per month respectively. Beyond that, SMS are billed at €0.06/SMS. The Communication plan offers SMS at €0.06/SMS from the first message.
